According to the Synodal appointment registers from this period, Archimandrite Markell was assigned to head the Pskov-Caves (Pskovo-Pechersky) Monastery in early 1730. His tenure was notably short—serving as an interim leader for roughly two years until further reshuffling in late 1731 led to his transfer.

The specific, brief tenure spanning 1730 to 1731 points directly to Markell.

Therefore, I support **F. Markell**.
